findings.title: Removing the only rendered input breaks ordinary Capsule typing and multiple existing flows
findings.evidence: draw_capsule_panes now draws only TextViewport. update_capsule:4714-4809 still routes prefix keys, ordinary editing, commits and focus through CAPSULE_INPUT. That ID is no longer rendered anywhere; the viewport update handles selection/copy, not terminal input. Independent public consumer at Paper 121x41 has a rendered CAPSULE_INPUT and visible typed hello before, neither after. Three unchanged full-flow tests fail at visible hello after launch, and exit/palette/menu flows also regress. All 15 full-crate failures were absent at exact parent revision.
findings.required_fix: Provide a real shared terminal/input-owner contract driven by current domain frame, caret, visibility and typed input actions. Route keyboard/paste/edit actions through the actually rendered owner and update application simulation via typed actions. Preserve frozen input and caret behavior without restoring the private frame painter, fake cursor, hidden registration or an extra input row without frozen authority.

findings.title: Disabled reasons are rendered as shortcut hints, changing frozen layout and behavior
findings.evidence: The pane context encodes Select text first, The clipboard is empty, Nothing is selected and One pane as MenuItem::hint. Frozen capsule.rs:330-348 uses reason() independently of shortcut(); frozen menu.rs:422-438 excludes reasons from width, :771-784 draws contextual reason in the bottom status row, and test:2323 explicitly requires that reason never widens the menu. Candidate reasons widen the menu and replace y / Ctrl+B z hints. Enabled Clear selection also receives an Esc hint absent from frozen pane context.
findings.required_fix: Add a reusable independent disabled-reason/status contract to the shared menu, retaining original shortcut hints and frozen reason placement/measurement. Remove the extra enabled Clear selection Esc hint. Do not paint reason rows in Jackin.

findings.title: Automatic tab menu title includes account suffixes which frozen title omits
findings.evidence: Frozen open_tab_menu at capsule.rs:360-370 calls daemon.tab_label(tab, &|_| None). New helper passes account.display_name as suffix. pty.rs:1768-1778 appends the returned suffix to agent labels, so a single-agent tab acquires e.g. Claude Code (account label). The new test sets custom_label and never exercises automatic titles.
findings.required_fix: Derive menu title according to the frozen automatic-label rule; retain live custom labels. Add changed-account and automatic-label coverage, independent of custom_label.

findings.title: The audit misclassifies introduced failures as existing
findings.evidence: The author reports 170 passed / 15 failed but calls captured-frame/cursor failures existing without a before comparison. Independent exact-base run passes 184/184. Every unchanged failing candidate case passed at base. Both revisions share the strict-Clippy warning; only that warning is established as pre-existing.
findings.required_fix: Record all 15 introduced failures, exact before/after revisions, independent logs and separate strict-lint failure. Do not waive these failures or describe the two added tests as sufficient for integration.

positive_scope: The exact 80x24/theme/scenario capsule_menu_80 selector, post-paint calls, static application capsule_menu_view and remaining menu invisible-cursor call are removed rather than renamed.
Tab context now exposes three typed actions and uses actual tab-part anchoring. Pane context uses seven domain actions and shared destructive confirmation.
The new caret test supplies an actual terminal caret and requires Some before comparing retained state; it no longer accepts None == None.
coverage_gaps: No real-CLI frozen capture/replay/candidate comparison, four-profile adjacent-size or pointer/resize/Unicode inventory was performed by this review.
No combined build on current PR38; candidate is based on older 1dee009.

Only split-right and close-pane are exercised by the two new author tests; dynamic automatic labels, rename, close-tab, paste/copy/clear, zoom, cancel/restoration and repeated resize/open-close need regression coverage.
Default terminal caret/input ownership remains unresolved; view-only retained caret after an injected click is not full live-terminal proof.

Other capsule zoom painter and application-owned geometry remain; exported obsolete termrock-feedback/src/capsule_menu.rs still exists with no production call sites found by source search. Removal requires public API/use audit, not a claim that all replay code is gone.
